q: In the Arnold–Liouville theorem, completely integrable systems (n degrees of freedom, n independent conserved quantities in involution) have:
opts: Orbits confined to n-dimensional tori (in phase space)
Orbits that fill all of phase space
exp: Arnold–Liouville: compact connected level sets of the n conserved quantities in involution are n-dimensional tori. The flow on each torus is quasi-periodic with n frequencies. KAM asks which tori survive perturbation.
